page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note at the left margin beside lines 4 to 5 ("Auic. cap. de caísia."). Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: 1. PHLEBOTOME partis oppositæ, si à sanguine est, aut materia sanguini mista: alioqui clementer purgamus. Repellentibus quoque vtendum: vt oleo rosato.
2. MATERIAE feruorem remittentibus, frigidis, & astringentibus: vt, syrup. rosato, granatorum, cum dupla aqua plantaginis, rosarum, solani, oxalidis, per dies quatuor, quinque.
3. EADEM vacuantibus, vt catapotijs minoribus hermodactylorum à drach. vna ad scriptula quatuor.

4. ANODYNIS à quibus incipiendum, et repellentibus: vt, farina hordei, vel casia fistula dissoluta in oleo rosato, vel succo, aut aqua solani, plantaginis. Medulla quoque panis, præcipuè secalini, lacte macerata & parum cocta: additis oui vitellis, et oleo rosato. Si autem dolor est intolerabilis, adde prædictis opij drach. vnam, croci ad penetrationem parum. Si magnus sentitur calor, muccago ex semine psyllij integro extracta, cum aqua rosarum, vel solani, pauco etiam aceto ad penetrationem

page.notes: <note side="left">Auic. cap. de caísia.</note> Catchword absent. Line ending "penetratio-/nem" is a catchword-like continuation shown at the right foot; transcribed as the word "nem" in the text. Some words in the left margin are faint and doubtful.
